jobs.title: Implementation Specialist
jobs.description:
**Job Description:**

**Title:** Implementation Specialist


**Location:** Remote – USA


**Reports to:** Manager, Implementation \- Dealer Solutions


**The Role:** The Implementation Specialist I is responsible for the successful onboarding and implementation of software solutions for new and existing customers. This role serves as the primary point of contact during the implementation process, ensuring customers are configured correctly, trained effectively, and prepared for a successful transition to ongoing Customer Success support.


The ideal candidate possesses excellent communication skills, strong organizational abilities, and a customer\-first mindset. This is an entry\-level implementation role designed to develop product knowledge, project management skills, and customer relationship experience.  



**The Impact You Will Have in This Role:** As an Implementation Specialist I, you will play a key role in setting customers up for success from the very beginning of their journey. By guiding clients through onboarding, system configuration, and training, you will help ensure they are confident, prepared, and able to quickly realize the value of the solution. Your ability to build relationships, communicate effectively, and manage implementation details will create a seamless customer experience and establish a strong foundation for long\-term satisfaction, adoption, and partnership. This role offers the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on both customer outcomes and overall business success while developing valuable expertise in implementation, project coordination, and customer engagement.


**What You’ll Be Doing in This Role:**

**Customer Onboarding**

* Manage assigned implementation projects from kickoff through completion.
* Coordinate implementation timelines with customers and internal teams.
* Schedule and conduct implementation meetings and training sessions.
* Ensure all required documentation is completed before launch.
* Verify customer system configurations meet implementation requirements.

**Software Configuration**

* Validate integrations and data connections.
* Perform quality assurance checks prior to go\-live.
* Troubleshoot basic configuration issues.
* Escalate technical concerns to Support or Engineering when appropriate.

**Customer Training**

* Deliver virtual and/or onsite product training.
* Educate users on workflows and best practices.
* Provide user guides, training videos, and additional learning resources.
* Confirm users understand key functionality before implementation is considered complete.
* Answer customer questions throughout the onboarding process.

**Project Management**

* Maintain accurate implementation records within the CRM or project management system.
* Track project milestones and deadlines.
* Provide implementation status updates to leadership.
* Identify risks that may delay implementation and communicate them proactively.
* Ensure projects remain on schedule.

**Customer Experience**

* Build positive relationships with customers.
* Maintain regular communication throughout the implementation process.
* Respond to customer inquiries professionally and promptly.
* Set appropriate expectations regarding timelines and deliverables.
* Deliver a high\-quality onboarding experience and will be presenting in front of clients.

**Internal Collaboration**

* Work closely with Sales and Customer Success
* Participate in team meetings and implementation planning sessions.
Share customer feedback that may improve products or processes.  
* 

**Qualifications of this Role:**

* High School Diploma or GED required
* Associate or bachelor’s degree preferred
* 1–3 years of customer service, software implementation, training, or project coordination
* 1\-3 Years Automotive Sales or Finance Experience
* Experience in presenting to customers is required
* Travel up to 100% will be required at times
* Excellent verbal and written communication
* Strong customer service skills
* Time management, and organizational skills
* Strong attention to detail and ability to prioritize multiple projects
* Basic project management skills
* Critical thinking and problem\-solving
* Adaptability in a fast\-paced environment
* Team\-oriented mindset

**Technical Skills**

Preferred familiarity with:


* CRM platforms (Sugar CRM, Salesforce)
* Microsoft Office Suite
* Google Workspace
* Microsoft Teams
* Web\-based software applications
Basic understanding of software integrations  
* 

**The Hiring Manager says:** This role is instrumental in ensuring our customers get off to a strong start. The Implementation Specialist I guides customers through onboarding, training, and implementation, helping them adopt our solutions with confidence and ease. Success in this role comes from delivering an exceptional customer experience, managing implementation milestones effectively, and collaborating across teams to ensure seamless handoffs. We're looking for someone who is customer\-focused, highly organized, eager to learn, and motivated to make a measurable impact on customer satisfaction, adoption, and long\-term success.


This position has a starting salary range of **$60,000 – $65,000 USD** per year. This is the range we reasonably and in good faith expect to pay for the role at the time of posting. An employee’s pay within the range is determined by a number of factors, including relevant skills, education, qualifications, experience, performance, business or organizational needs, and geographic location.  



**Company Mission**

Our mission in the market we serve is clear. To power every auto\-related decision through proprietary data, advanced analytics, deep industry expertise, and seamless workflows that connect insight to action.


**Our Values**

We POWER Our Customer's Success


We are Innovative, Collaborative and Grounded in Data


We Make Things Easy


We Get It Done


We Start with Trust \& Prove it Everyday


JD Power is committed to employing a diverse workforce. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or disability.


Should you require accommodations during the recruitment and selection process, please reach out to tarecruitment@jdpa.com.


JD Power does not disclose your personal data to unauthorized third parties. However, as a global corporation consisting of multiple affiliated companies in various countries, JD Power has international sites and JD Power uses resources located throughout the world. JD Power may from time to time also use third parties to act on JD Power’s behalf. You agree to the fact that to the extent necessary your personal data may be transferred and/or disclosed to any company within JD Power group of companies as well as to third parties acting on JD Power’s behalf, including also transfers to servers and databases outside the country where you provided JD Power with your personal data. Such transfers may include for example transfers and/or disclosures outside the European Economic Area and in the United States of America. If you are a California or United Kingdom resident, additional disclosures about the information we collect and how we use that information can be found by clicking here.


*To all recruitment agencies: JD Power does not accept unsolicited agency resumes and we are not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.*

jobs.title: Client Onboarding Specialist - Complex Accounts
jobs.description:
**About Wealth Enhancement**

  

Wealth Enhancement is an independent wealth management firm with an endless passion for enriching the lives of our clients. We continually seek to perfect our craft of personalized financial planning with our team\-based Roundtable and UniFi processes that go far beyond the standard approach. We proudly provide unique financial plans and investment management services to over 90,000 households from our over 175 offices \- and growing \- nationwide.

  

Since 1997, Wealth Enhancement has tirelessly raised the standard of wealth management with specialized knowledge and more attentive service that helps every client craft their future. For more information, please visit www.wealthenhancement.com.

  

We have an exciting opportunity for a **Client Onboarding Specialist – Complex Accounts**! The Client Onboarding Specialist – Complex Accounts is an experienced onboarding professional responsible for managing a full range of new client account openings, including standard and complex registrations. This role serves as a subject matter resource for trusts, estates, business entities, and other non\-standard account structures, while helping deliver an accurate, efficient, and client\-friendly onboarding experience. The Specialist also supports scalable onboarding processes and capabilities for high\-net\-worth and ultra\-high\-net\-worth clients.


This is a **fully r****emote** position. We're open to candidates located across the United States, however you must be available to work 9am\-5pm **P****acific**.


In the spirit of pay transparency, we are excited to share the base salary range for this position is **$70,000\.00 to $85,000\.00**, exclusive of bonuses and benefits. The position is also eligible to participate in our Corporate Bonus Plan. We encourage you to apply and provide us with your compensation expectations when you do. We're big on open conversations, so, let's have one.

**Primary Job Functions**

**Client Onboarding**

* Independently manage onboarding for standard and complex account types.
* Prepare and review WEAS and custodial documentation and establish accurate account records in Salesforce.
* Review trust, estate, and entity documentation for completeness, consistency, and appropriate registration.
* Manage outstanding requirements, NIGO items, exceptions, and documentation issues through resolution.
* Ensure onboarding activities comply with WEG policies, Suitability Guidelines, custodian requirements, and applicable regulations.

**Quality Control \& Issue Resolution**

* Perform quality review of onboarding documentation to ensure accuracy and completeness, including work completed by offshore team members.
* Research and resolve account\-opening issues in partnership with Advisor Teams, custodians, Supervision, Operations, and other internal teams.
* Identify missing or inconsistent information and determine appropriate next steps.
* Escalate unusual, higher\-risk, or complex situations as appropriate.

**Advisor \& Internal Support**

* Serve as the primary liaison between RVPs, Advisor Teams and Client Onboarding, acting as the first point of contact for onboarding questions, status updates, and issue resolution.
* Serve as a subject matter resource, providing guidance on onboarding requirements, documentation, and complex registrations.
* Provide training, mentorship, and technical support to junior onboarding team members.

**Process Improvement**

* Help develop and maintain onboarding playbooks, checklists, documentation standards, and escalation procedures.
* Identify opportunities to improve workflows, reduce rework, and improve the Advisor and client experience.
* Contribute to scalable processes and service standards for standard and complex, including ultra\-high\-net\-worth clients, onboarding needs.
* Participate in process and system enhancements, including Salesforce\-related improvements.

**Leadership \& Autonomy**

* Independently manages onboarding requests, including complex and non\-standard accounts.
* Takes ownership of day\-to\-day Advisor Team support, escalating issues to management when appropriate.
* Serves as an escalation point and subject matter resource for complex account\-opening needs.
* Provides guidance and mentorship to junior team members.

**KPIs**

* Accuracy and completeness of account\-opening documentation.
* Timeliness of onboarding and issue resolution.
* NIGO and rework rates.
* Responsiveness and quality of support to Advisor Teams and internal partners.

**Education/Qualifications**

* 5\+ years of financial services experience, including hands\-on client onboarding and account\-opening experience.
* Experience opening complex accounts, including trusts, estates, LLCs, partnerships, corporations, and other entities.
* Strong knowledge of account registrations, ownership structures, and documentation requirements.
* Strong attention to detail, communication, organization, and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and independently drive issues to resolution.
* Experience with Schwab Advisor Center and/or Fidelity WealthScape strongly preferred.
* 4\-year college degree preferred.

*WEG hires employees and makes decisions about their salary qualifications based on factors such as the role to be performed; educational and professional experience, qualifications, skills and credentials; tenure, cost\-of\-living and demand for the role in the applicable market. To comply with state, pay transparency laws, we must disclose the entire salary grade. The entire salary grade for those who are classified as this level is $67,300\.00 to $97,600\.00\. However, the base salary range bolded above* ***($70,000\.00 to $85,000\.00****) is what we expect to pay as a starting range for this position.*


\#LI\-REMOTE


\#LI\-AP1

**Comprehensive Benefits Offerings**


Our benefits aim to balance four key elements that make life and work meaningful: health and wellness, financial well\-being, professional development, and work/life harmony. You may be eligible to participate in the following benefits \& development opportunities:

* Training and professional development
* Medical, dental and vision coverage (Available to full\-time employees and their families)
* Health Savings Account (HSA) with employer contribution and Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) for medical, dependent, and transit expenses
* Life and AD\&D insurance – employer paid and voluntary options
* Short\-term and long\-term disability, workers compensation – employer paid
* 401k with match and profit sharing
* Wellness programs and resources
* Voluntary benefits, including pet insurance
* 18 days of paid time off (PTO), accrued annually (25 PTO days after 4 years of service)
* 12 paid holidays each year (10 pre\-determined and 2 floating days)
* Paid parental leave and paid caregiver leave (Caregiver leave available after 6 months of tenure)
* Reimbursement for tuition, licensing, and other credentials (Available after meeting service requirements)

**Should you need reasonable accommodation when completing the application form or during the selection** **process, contact the Human Resources Department at 763\-417\-1700**

 **Information provided on this application will be kept confidential and only be shared with those involved in the selection process.**  

  

**Equal Opportunity Employer, including disabled and veterans. This organization participates in E\-Verify.**

**Click the following link to view Federal and E\-Verify posters:** Link


OSHA Requirements: This position requires the ability to stand or sit for long periods of time, file documents in high or low cabinets, to use the telephone and to use the computer systems.

All AI\-supported evaluations are reviewed by our recruitment team to ensure accuracy and fairness. We are committed to equal opportunity in employment and do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or any other protected status. Your personal information is handled in accordance with applicable data protection laws.

jobs.title: Implementation Specialist, IT
jobs.description:
**About Rippling**

  

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

  

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

  

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.2B from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

 **About the role**


As an Implementation Specialist, IT you will partner with our largest customers (US and Global). You will be working with our customers’ IT departments to understand their requirements and guide/train them to adopt our Apps, Devices, Identity, and Inventory Management Solutions. You will manage an evolving book of business and be the internal go\-to for all things related to Rippling’s IT solution.

  

The IT implementation team at Rippling is growing, along with our focus on our IT solutions. This role offers a unique opportunity to not only work with our largest customers but also work cross\-functionally to improve our product, adoption, and customer experience for IT.

 **What you will do**

* Become an expert on Rippling’s IT offering\- You’ll be a go\-to resource for our clients within 30 days and an IT subject matter expert for your Rippling colleagues within 60 days.
* Be a trusted implementation partner to our clients:
* + You’ll need to understand the client’s current technology requirements as it relates to Rippling.
	+ You’ll need to guide the customer to install and adopt Rippling’s IT solutions
	+ You’ll need to train the customer on Rippling IT products
	+ You’ll work closely with Implementation and the rest of the Customer Experience organization to ensure the client is set up for success.
* Partner with our Solutions Consulting, Implementation, and Product teams to evolve our process and product
* Develop and document IT implementation processes and best practices.

**What you will need**

* A passion and curiosity for all things related to IT
* 4\+ years of experience managing an IT set\-up at a company, helping customers implement IT products, or selling IT solutions. This role requires a strong understanding of the below:
* + **Fleet Management, UEM, RMM, MDM, device and identity provisioning, Zero Touch, and Endpoint Lifecycle Management. Familiarity with other IT products such as Google, Azure and Okta.**
* Strong project management and organizational skills: high attention to detail with excellent time management skills.
* Ability to manage client relationships: strong communication and presentation skills
* Self\-starter with a bias towards action, energized by a fast\-paced environment and excited to build

**Additional information**

  

Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accommodations@rippling.com.


Rippling highly values having employees working in\-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. For office\-based employees (employees who live within a 40 mile radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role.


This role will receive a competitive salary \+ benefits \+ equity. The salary for US\-based employees will be aligned with one of the ranges below based on location; see which tier applies to your location here.


A variety of factors are considered when determining someone’s compensation–including a candidate’s professional background, experience, and location. Final offer amounts may vary from the amounts listed below.

  

\#li\-remote

 **The pay range for this role is:**  

58,320 \- 92,000 USD per year(US Tier 2\)  

55,080 \- 87,000 USD per year(US Tier 3\)

jobs.title: Senior Implementation Specialist
jobs.location: San Francisco Bay Area, CA, US
jobs.description:
Restaurant365 is a SaaS company disrupting the restaurant industry! Our cloud\-based platform provides a unique, centralized solution for accounting and back\-office operations for restaurants. Restaurant365’s culture is focused on empowering team members to produce top\-notch results while elevating their skills. We’re constantly evolving and improving to make sure we are and always will be “Best in Class” ... and we want that for you too!  


The Senior Implementation Specialist is a key expert within the Professional Services team, responsible for delivering high\-touch, high\-complexity onboarding experiences for our most strategic customers—typically enterprise\-level or multi\-unit restaurant groups. This role combines advanced solution knowledge, project leadership, and customer relationship skills to ensure implementations are executed efficiently, drive rapid adoption, and set the foundation for long\-term customer success.



The Senior Specialist will partner closely with Project Managers, Solutions Architects, and Customer Success Managers to design and execute tailored onboarding plans that address unique customer workflows, integrations, and operational structures. Beyond direct delivery, this role serves as a mentor and quality benchmark for other Implementation Specialists, helping raise the bar on consistency, methodology, and customer experience across the team.

  


### **How you'll add value:**

* Lead complex, enterprise\-scale implementations from discovery to adoption, ensuring alignment between customer requirements and R365’s platform capabilities to manage milestones on time and within budget to deliver smooth and complete project experience for customers.
* Conduct advanced discovery sessions to deeply understand multi\-location, multi\-system workflows, and configure solutions to maximize operational efficiency.
* Deliver expert\-level training (virtual or onsite) that drives confident end\-user adoption, tailoring content to different audience levels—from executives to frontline staff.
* Apply deep product expertise to advise on complex use cases, integrations, and best practices, ensuring customers maximize the full value of the platform.
* Mentor and coach junior Implementation Specialists, providing feedback, sharing best practices, and contributing to internal training programs.
* Collaborate cross\-functionally with Project Management, Solutions Architecture, Product, and Support to resolve issues, address custom requirements, and ensure delivery excellence.
* Contribute to continuous improvement by identifying process gaps, suggesting enhancements to implementation playbooks, and piloting new delivery approaches.
* Proactively manage risk, surfacing adoption blockers early and developing mitigation strategies to keep projects on track.
* Other duties as assigned.

 **KEY METRICS FOR SUCCESS**



* Utilization Rate
* Project Completion Throughput
* On\-Time Delivery Rate
* Customer Satisfaction (CSAT)

  


### **What you'll need to be successful in this role:**

* 5\+ years of hands\-on experience in SaaS onboarding or implementation, with a proven track record of successfully guiding customers through technical setup, training, and go\-live across varied business types and user groups while consistently achieving key performance metrics.
* Experience managing complex, high\-touch implementations with proven project management skills.
* Deep understanding of multiple R365 product lines: Accounting, Operations, ExpandShare, and HIRE
* Exceptional organizational and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously, prioritize effectively, and meet tight deadlines without sacrificing quality.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to lead client\-facing trainings and translate technical concepts into clear, actionable guidance for both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Highly analytical and solutions\-oriented, able to assess requirements, troubleshoot issues, and make timely, data\-informed decisions that support customer success.
* Self\-starter with the ability to work independently, while also demonstrating strong collaboration skills when working cross\-functionally with Project Managers, Engineers, Product, and Customer Success.
* Demonstrated coaching or mentorship experience.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Proven SaaS tool fluency, sound technical knowledge, and detail orientation.

  


**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**



* Familiarity with restaurant or hospitality environments.
* Experience in structured certification programs or internal training content.
* Experience shaping onboarding frameworks and internal tools.
* Comfort adapting to evolving playbooks and tools.
### **R365 Team Member Benefits \& Perks**

* Competitive compensation package
* Comprehensive medical benefits
* 401k \+ matching
* Team member stock options
* Flexible Time Off \+ Company holidays
* Weekly catered lunches \+ snacks
* Wellness initiatives

**This role is hybrid, balancing flexibility with the value of in\-person collaboration. To support connection, partnership, and team effectiveness, employees are expected to work onsite each Tuesday and Wednesday.**
Internal Employees \- R365 is committed to growing talent from within. If you see a role that excites you and you meet the qualifications, we encourage you to apply \-regardless of your current location or work arrangement. Reach out to your People Business Partner if you have questions.  


  

DYN365, Inc d/b/a Restaurant365 is an equal opportunity employer.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Implementation Specialist
jobs.description:
**Implementation Specialist**
=============================

**About the Role**
------------------


Prospyr is looking for an **Implementation Specialist** to help new customers successfully transition onto Prospyr and get their teams operational as quickly and confidently as possible.


You’ll own the implementation process from post\-sale handoff through go\-live, coordinating configuration, data migration, workflows, training, and launch readiness.


This role is highly project\-oriented. You'll manage multiple implementations simultaneously while working closely with customers and internal teams to keep projects organized, remove blockers, and ensure customers are prepared to operate successfully in Prospyr.

**What You'll Own**
-------------------

### **Implementation Project Management**

* Own customer implementations from Sales handoff through successful go\-live.
* Build and manage implementation plans, milestones, responsibilities, and timelines.
* Coordinate customer and internal stakeholders throughout the project.
* Identify risks, dependencies, and blockers early and drive them toward resolution.
* Maintain clear communication around project status and next steps.

### **Platform Configuration**

* Guide customers through configuration of their Prospyr environment.
* Help customers translate existing operational workflows into Prospyr.
* Coordinate setup across areas such as:


	+ Providers and staff
	+ Locations
	+ Scheduling
	+ Services and catalog
	+ Forms and consents
	+ Payments
	+ Patient communications
	+ Inventory
	+ Memberships
	+ Online booking
	+ Integrations and other applicable features
* Validate configuration prior to go\-live.

### **Data Migration \& Integrations**

* Coordinate data migration requirements between customers and internal technical teams.
* Help customers understand what data is required and how it should be prepared.
* Track migration progress and validate readiness with the customer.
* Coordinate third\-party integrations and dependencies when applicable.
* Escalate technical blockers with clear documentation and business impact.

### **Training \& Go\-Live Readiness**

* Coordinate and deliver role\-based customer training.
* Ensure administrators, providers, front\-desk teams, and other users understand the workflows relevant to their roles.
* Develop a clear go\-live readiness checklist for each implementation.
* Identify knowledge gaps before launch and coordinate additional training where needed.
* Provide additional support during the transition into live operations.

### **Process Improvement**

* Identify recurring implementation friction and opportunities to improve Prospyr's onboarding process.
* Help develop implementation templates, playbooks, checklists, documentation, and training resources.
* Partner with Product and Engineering on recurring implementation blockers.
* Help move repeatable onboarding activities toward scalable self\-service experiences.

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

* Customers launch on time with minimal disruption to their businesses.
* Implementation timelines and responsibilities are clear to customers and internal teams.
* Data migration and configuration issues are identified before go\-live.
* Customers enter ongoing CX management with strong platform knowledge and clearly defined workflows.
* Time\-to\-value and time\-to\-go\-live improve as implementation processes become more standardized.
* Fewer post\-launch support issues originate from incomplete configuration or training.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* 2–4\+ years of SaaS implementation, onboarding, project management, or customer success experience.
* Strong project\-management and organizational skills.
* Ability to manage multiple customer implementations simultaneously.
* Comfortable learning complex software and becoming highly proficient in product configuration.
* Strong customer communication and training skills.
* Ability to troubleshoot problems and coordinate effectively with technical teams.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-moving environment where processes continue to evolve.
* Healthcare, EMR, medical aesthetics, wellness, payments, or vertical SaaS experience is a plus.

**Role Philosophy**
-------------------


Implementation owns the question:

**“What needs to happen to get this customer successfully live on Prospyr?”**


The Implementation Specialist drives that process from beginning to end, while creating a clean transition to the CXM who will own the customer's long\-term success.

Applicants in the State of New York may request an alternative process by contacting us at VFaccessibility@rescocompany.com.
